text:
Ravi: small design check: in the new dashboard form should we show inline errors as users type or wait until submit? also how to handle required indicators on dense forms? Joan: inline as-you-type for validation that can be deterministically checked (format, length). for missing required fields wait until submit to avoid noise. Leo: agree. for required markers i vote for explicit "Required" label on grouped fields, asterisk only where space is tight. add `aria-required="true"` on inputs. Priya: quick copy thought: instead of "This field is required" use action-first like "Enter an email address" — tests show it's clearer. Ravi: good point. what about error summary at top? Joan: include only after submit and only when there are 3+ errors. summary should be a focusable container that links to each field. Leo: accessibility note: use `role="alert"` for inline errors that appear after user interaction, but for the summary use `aria-live="polite"` so screenreader doesn't interrupt. Priya: delete confirmation copy: current modal says "Delete" — users confuse it with soft remove. propose: "Permanently delete route" + explanation line. for bulk deletes require typing the exact name. Ravi: for single-item quick deletes maybe a checkbox "I understand this cannot be undone" is enough. typed confirm only for production-tagged items or bulk. Joan: UX nit: after submit with errors focus should move to the summary, then keyboard users can tab into the first field. ensure the summary items have clear link text e.g., "Name: missing" -> focus name field. Leo: small front-end example: ```
3 errors found
``` then anchor links to `#field-id` Priya: also don't rely on color alone for error state. include icon + short text and make sure contrast meets AA. Ravi: ok. plan: Joan will mock two variants (live-inline vs submit-summary) in figs, Leo will drop a tiny pattern PR for `aria-invalid`/summary focus, Priya will craft concise vs explicit delete copy. aria-bot: a11y checklist: https://intranet.redwood/a11y/checklist Joan: will post mocks by tomorrow morning. Leo: PR ready by EOW. Priya: copy in #docs by EOD. Ravi: thanks team, if no objections i'll lock these as the default pattern for the next sprint. Joan: no objections from design. Leo: engineering ok. Priya: ok from copy.
